geometry: A 7-pixel-wide dark key occupies x=2–8 and y=0–35 on a transparent 10 by 37 canvas. Its opaque outer body contains a vertical face gradient, brighter side bevels, and a bottom edge; the surrounding 118 pixels are fully transparent in the source.
limitations: The source’s slight tonal variation is approximated with smooth linear gradients; the native and 8× renders were inspected over dark and white backgrounds.
